newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDESpar to sell Petrobras shrs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDESpar to sell Petrobras shrs.

text.p: BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), is preparing a global offering of preference shares in state oil monopoly Petrobras, a senior bank official said.
BNDESpar Director Sergio Veguelin said the bank planned to sell off Petrobras preference shares worth up to $300 million. BNDESpar holds a total of Petrobras preference shares worth $2.8 billion.

The shares will be placed on the Brazilian and European markets, as well as in the United States as Level One American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), Veguelin said. Petrobras is currently traded over the counter in the pink sheets in the U.S.
He said BNDESpar is due to select a coordinator for the global offering from a group of 14 banks in the next few weeks, and if all went as planned the offer would take place in May.
The 14 banks have until Friday to present their proposals.

Veguelin said BNDESpar was interested in making further global offerings of up to $1 billion of Petrobras preference shares this year, but only if Petrobras lists its shares in the United States as either Level Two or Level Three ADRs.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
